title: Life Restart Sim
description: Roll wild starting talents, allocate your core attributes, and tap through hilarious year-by-year life twists from humble beginnings to billionaire mogul or cosmic legend.
controls: Tap to draw random talents, assign your starting stats (Charm, Intelligence, Physique, Wealth), and click through each year of your unpredictable life.

zh-CN.title: 人生重开模拟器
zh-CN.description: 国民级爆火文字模拟神作：随机十连抽逆天天赋、自由分配颜值智力体质家境，一键重开解锁暴富修仙等百种奇葩结局！
zh-CN.controls: 点击抽取开局天赋并分配初始属性，连续点击推进每年随机人生事件直至解锁结局成就。
